55	
56	        ```python
57	        >>> from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer, TextStreamer
58	
59	        >>> tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("openai-community/gpt2")
60	        >>> model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained("openai-community/gpt2")
61	        >>> inputs = tok(["An increasing sequence: one,"], return_tensors="pt")
62	        >>> streamer = TextStreamer(tok)
63	
64	        >>> # Despite returning the usual output, the streamer will also print the generated text to stdout.
65	        >>> _ = model.generate(**inputs, streamer=streamer, max_new_tokens=20)

Based on my exploration of the huggingface-transformers codebase, here is a comprehensive structured summary of both subsystems:

---

## 1. GENERATION SUBSYSTEM (`src/transformers/generation/`)

### File List and Main Classes:

**`utils.py`** - Core generation implementation
- `GenerationMixin` - Main mixin class providing `generate()` and related methods for all generative models
- Key methods: `generate()`, `greedy_search()`, `sample()`, `beam_search()`, `contrastive_search()`, `assisted_decoding()`
- Contains beam search logic, speculative decoding, and assisted generation implementations

**`configuration_utils.py`** - Generation configuration
- `GenerationConfig` - Dataclass containing all generation parameters (temperature, top_k, top_p, max_length, etc.)
- `GenerationMode` - Enum defining generation modes (GREEDY_SEARCH, SAMPLE, BEAM_SEARCH, CONTRASTIVE_SEARCH, ASSISTED_GENERATION, DOLA_GENERATION, etc.)

**`logits_process.py`** - Logit processors and warpers
- `LogitsProcessor` - Abstract base class
- `LogitsProcessorList` - Container for applying multiple processors
- **Processors**: `MinLengthLogitsProcessor`, `MinNewTokensLengthLogitsProcessor`, `RepetitionPenaltyLogitsProcessor`, `EncoderRepetitionPenaltyLogitsProcessor`, `NoRepeatNGramLogitsProcessor`, `EncoderNoRepeatNGramLogitsProcessor`, `SequenceBiasLogitsProcessor`, `NoBadWordsLogitsProcessor`, `PrefixConstrainedLogitsProcessor`, `ForcedBOSTokenLogitsProcessor`, `ForcedEOSTokenLogitsProcessor`, `InfNanRemoveLogitsProcessor`, `ExponentialDecayLengthPenalty`, `LogitNormalization`, `SuppressTokensAtBeginLogitsProcessor`, `SuppressTokensLogitsProcessor`, `WhisperTimeStampLogitsProcessor`, `WhisperNoSpeechDetection`, `ClassifierFreeGuidanceLogitsProcessor`, `AlternatingCodebooksLogitsProcessor`, `UnbatchedClassifierFreeGuidanceLogitsProcessor`, `BarkEosPrioritizerLogitsProcessor`, `WatermarkLogitsProcessor`, `SynthIDTextWatermarkLogitsProcessor`, `DiaClassifierFreeGuidanceLogitsProcessor`, `DiaEOSChannelFilterLogitsProcessor`, `DiaEOSDelayPatternLogitsProcessor`
- **Warpers**: `TemperatureLogitsWarper`, `TopPLogitsWarper`, `TopKLogitsWarper`, `TopHLogitsWarper`, `MinPLogitsWarper`, `TypicalLogitsWarper`, `EpsilonLogitsWarper`, `EtaLogitsWarper`

**`stopping_criteria.py`** - Stopping conditions
- `StoppingCriteria` - Abstract base class
- `StoppingCriteriaList` - Container for multiple criteria
- `MaxLengthCriteria` - Stop at max token length
- `MaxTimeCriteria` - Stop after time limit
- `StopStringCriteria` - Stop when specific strings appear
- `EosTokenCriteria` - Stop at EOS token
- `ConfidenceCriteria` - Stop based on assistant model confidence

**`streamers.py`** - Text streaming during generation
- `BaseStreamer` - Abstract base class
- `TextStreamer` - Prints tokens as they're generated
- `TextIteratorStreamer` - Non-blocking iterator for generated text
- `AsyncTextIteratorStreamer` - Async iterator version
- `TextDiffusionStreamer` - For text diffusion models

**`candidate_generator.py`** - Speculative decoding / assisted generation
- `CandidateGenerator` - Abstract base class
- `AssistedCandidateGenerator` - Uses smaller assistant model for candidate generation
- `AssistedCandidateGeneratorDifferentTokenizers` - For models with different tokenizers (UAD)
- `UniversalSpeculativeDecodingGenerator` - Universal speculative decoding across tokenizers
- `PromptLookupCandidateGenerator` - Looks up candidates in the prompt itself
- `EarlyExitCandidateGenerator` - Uses main model with early exit
- `SinglePositionMultiTokenCandidateGenerator` - MTP-style single-position prediction
- `MTPCandidateGenerator` - Multi-token prediction with hidden states

**`watermarking.py`** - Text watermarking utilities

**`__init__.py`** - Public API exports

---

## 2. TRAINING SUBSYSTEM (Top-level files)

### Core Training Files:

**`trainer.py`** - Main Trainer class
- `Trainer` - Core training class with `train()`, `evaluate()`, `predict()` methods
- Handles distributed training, checkpointing, logging, evaluation loops
- Integrations with DeepSpeed, FSDP, PEFT, NeFTune

**`trainer_seq2seq.py`** - Sequence-to-sequence training
- `Seq2SeqTrainer(Trainer)` - Extends Trainer for seq2seq models (T5, BART, mBART, Marian)
- Handles generation during evaluation, `generate()` integration, `prefix_tuning`

**`training_args.py`** - Training configuration
- `TrainingArguments` - Dataclass containing all training hyperparameters (output_dir, num_train_epochs, per_device_train_batch_size, learning_rate, warmup_steps, logging_steps, save_steps, eval_steps, fp16, bf16, gradient_accumulation_steps, etc.)
- `OptimizerNames` - Enum for optimizer choices (adamw_torch, adamw_hf, adafactor, etc.)
- `ParallelMode` - Enum for distributed training modes

**`training_args_seq2seq.py`** - Seq2Seq-specific training arguments
- `Seq2SeqTrainingArguments(TrainingArguments)` - Extends with generation_config, prediction_bias_only

**`trainer_callback.py`** - Training callbacks
- `TrainerCallback` - Abstract base for callbacks with `on_step_begin`, `on_step_end`, `on_epoch_begin`, `on_epoch_end`, `on_evaluate`, `on_save`, etc.
- `TrainerState` - Dataclass holding training state (epoch, global_step, log_history, best_metric, etc.)
- `TrainerControl` - Controls training flow (`should_training_stop`, `should_epoch_stop`, `should_save`, `should_evaluate`)
- `ExportableState` - Base class for state save/load capability
- `CallbackHandler` - Internal handler for managing callbacks
- `DefaultFlowCallback` - Default logging/evaluation/checkpoint flow
- `ProgressCallback` - Progress bar display
- `PrinterCallback` - Simple text logging
- `EarlyStoppingCallback` - Early stopping on metric plateau

**`trainer_utils.py`** - Training utilities
- `EvalLoopOutput`, `PredictionOutput`, `TrainOutput` - NamedTuples for results
- `EvalPrediction` - Evaluation predictions and labels
- `IntervalStrategy`, `SaveStrategy`, `HubStrategy` - Enums for when to take actions
- `HPSearchBackend` - Enum for hyperparameter search backends (optuna, ray, wandb)
- `SchedulerType` - Enum for LR schedulers (linear, cosine, polynomial, constant, inverse_sqrt, cosine_with_restarts, etc.)
- `FSDPOption` - Enum for FSDP sharding modes
- `TrainerMemoryTracker` - GPU/CPU memory tracking
- Helper functions: `seed_worker`, `set_seed`, `enable_full_determinism`, `speed_metrics`, `get_last_checkpoint`, etc.

**`trainer_pt_utils.py`** - PyTorch-specific utilities
- `DistributedSamplerWithLoop` - Sampler that loops back to start
- `EvalLoopContainer` - Container for evaluation loop results
- `LengthGroupedSampler` - Groups samples by similar length
- `DistributedLengthGroupedSampler` - Distributed version of length grouping
- `ShardSampler` - Shards batches across processes
- `LayerWiseDummyOptimizer` - Dummy optimizer for layer-wise optimizers
- `LayerWiseDummyScheduler` - Dummy scheduler for layer-wise optimizers
- Helper functions: `nested_concat`, `find_batch_size`, `nested_detach`, `distributed_broadcast_scalars`, `get_parameter_names`, `IterableDatasetShard`, `LabelSmoother`, `remove_dummy_checkpoint`

**`trainer_optimizer.py`** - Optimizer handling
- `OptimizerContext` - Dataclass for optimizer context (args, model, kwargs)
- `OptimizerHandler` - Type alias for optimizer factory functions
- `_parse_optim_args` - Parse optimizer arguments from string
- `is_optimizer_factory` - Check if optimizer is factory function
- Integration with various optimizers: AdamW (torch, hf, apex), Adafactor, bitsandbytes, GaLore, Lomo, ScheduleFree, etc.

**`trainer_jit_checkpoint.py`** - Just-in-time checkpointing
- `CheckpointManager` - Manages JIT checkpoint on SIGTERM
- `JITCheckpointCallback` - Callback for SIGTERM-triggered checkpointing

**`optimization.py`** - Optimizers and schedulers
- `Adafactor(Optimizer)` - Memory-efficient optimizer
- `AdafactorSchedule(LambdaLR)` - LR scheduler proxy for Adafactor
- Scheduler functions: `get_constant_schedule`, `get_constant_schedule_with_warmup`, `get_linear_schedule_with_warmup`, `get_cosine_schedule_with_warmup`, `get_cosine_with_hard_restarts_schedule_with_warmup`, `get_polynomial_decay_schedule_with_warmup`, `get_inverse_sqrt_schedule`, `get_reduce_on_plateau_schedule`, `get_scheduler`

---

## 3. LOSS SUBSYSTEM (`src/transformers/loss/`)

### File List:

**`loss_utils.py`** - Core loss functions and exports
- `ForCausalLMLoss` - Causal LM loss with label shifting
- `ForMaskedLMLoss` - Masked LM loss
- `ForSequenceClassificationLoss` - Classification loss
- `fixed_cross_entropy` - Cross entropy with sum reduction

**`loss_for_object_detection.py`** - DETR-style object detection
- `ImageLoss` - DETR object detection/segmentation loss with Hungarian matching
- `HungarianMatcher` - Hungarian algorithm for matching predictions to targets
- `NestedTensor` - Tensor + mask container

**`loss_d_fine.py`** - D-FINE detection loss
- `DFineLoss(RTDetrLoss)` - D-FINE object detection loss

**`loss_deformable_detr.py`** - Deformable DETR loss
- `DeformableDetrForObjectDetectionLoss`
- `DeformableDetrForSegmentationLoss`

**`loss_deimv2.py`** - Deimv2 detection loss
- `Deimv2ForObjectDetectionLoss`

**`loss_grounding_dino.py`** - Grounding DINO loss
- `GroundingDinoForObjectDetectionLoss`

**`loss_lw_detr.py`** - Lightweight DETR loss
- `LwDetrForObjectDetectionLoss`

**`loss_rf_detr.py`** - Real-time DETR loss
- `RfDetrForSegmentationLoss`

**`loss_rt_detr.py`** - RT-DETR loss
- `RTDetrForObjectDetectionLoss`

**`loss_tdt.py`** - TDT loss
- `ParakeetForTDTLoss`

**`loss_rnnt.py`** - RNN-T loss
- `ParakeetForRNNTLoss` - RNN-Transducer loss

**`__init__.py`** - Public API exports

---
